method.files_glob: *.png directly in docs/shots/release, review subdir excluded
method.grouping: 375 tall sections cropped to <=1500px bands and stitched horizontally (750 or 1125px wide); 1280 tall sections cropped to separate band files; 375 fold captures grouped into 3-up panels (1125px wide); folder/ecosystem re-banded to content region after pixel scan
method.mechanical_cross_check: PIL ImageChops row-gap scan run over all 71 originals

inspected: 1280-light-section-ecosystem.png (direct, plus second read for folder count)
not_inspected: no source PNG was skipped; all 71 opened

generated artifacts never opened by vision: review/1280-dark-section-stack.band0.png, review/1280-dark-section-stack.band1.png, review/1280-light-section-stack.band0.png, review/1280-light-section-stack.band1.png (full 1677px images were read instead)

defects.observation: Capture is 4107px tall but holds only two content blocks: header block y0-400 and folder cards y1600-2600, with a ~1200px empty band between them and ~1600px empty tail. Vision reads only 3 folder cards (SPAN Global Services, Ampliz, IP Momentum) in the ecosystem capture and 5 (Champions Accelerator open, Champions Infometrics, SPAN, Ampliz, IP Momentum) in the folder-open capture, against 11-12 on desktop and copy that says twelve companies. Pixel shape identical in dark and light.
defects.fix: Render every company folder in first paint on <=480px (no scroll-reveal or lazy gating), and remove the fixed block height or row gap producing the ~1200px band between the header block and the first folder; re-capture at 375.
defects.evidence: pixel row scan (gap and tail numbers exact); folder counts are vision reads, not DOM
defects.status: hypothesis for parent probe: open preview at 375 and scroll the ecosystem section

defects.element: Mission Log contribution graph vs streak stats block
defects.observation: The tilted 3D contribution canvas overlaps the stats row (Longest streak, Current streak, 1 year total, Busiest day), covering the text and the heatmap month labels Nov/Dec/Jan; Reading position 0% label sits off its bar and monthly counts are not right-aligned to a common edge.
defects.fix: Place the stats outside the canvas stacking context (separate grid cell with its own padding), reserve vertical space for month labels under the canvas, and align Reading position value to the bar track.
defects.evidence: same overlap read independently in both themes

defects.element: Ask Deep chat panel and chat FAB overlay
defects.observation: Open chat panel or FAB covers real content in 13 captures: Circaloo/Ciraloo folder and Lake B2B edge (folder-open), full DMS I ANSWER sidebar plus its lowest quick action (section-human), WHERE THE ESSAY SPENT chart (section-writing), THE TWELVE / Champions Club and copyright rows (footers desktop and mobile), day 347 building tag (section-log band1), terrain card corner (section-top), listen card speed control (375 week-48), footer Book a call button (375 footer), terminal mockup (lane-7).
defects.fix: Capture release screenshots with chat closed; live side, cap the panel at 360px and add bottom/right inset padding so it never sits on a link or chart, and on <=480px open it as a full sheet rather than an overlay over footer links.
defects.evidence: repeated independent reads across themes and viewports
defects.status: hypothesis for capture state and live overlay geometry

defects.element: Account page, Shared credit balance card
defects.observation: Providers configured row has a label with an empty value cell; Daily credit cap and Daily row cap render as empty tracks with no fill and no value; sign in to see your balance sits in low-contrast gray.
defects.fix: Render an explicit value in every row (count, or none set), show a no-cap state label inside the track instead of a blank bar, and raise the sign-in helper text to the secondary-text token.
defects.evidence: identical in dark and light, desktop and mobile
defects.status: hypothesis, state may be intended when backend unconfigured

defects.element: Kokonut terrain and heatmap last column
defects.observation: Rightmost tower plus its selected white outline is cut by the card edge at 1600 (1600-dark-home); rightmost heatmap square is cut by the card edge in section-top at 1280 and 375; the section-log grid rightmost hatched cells run into the image edge.
defects.fix: Give the widget horizontal padding equal to one cell, or make the grid horizontally scrollable inside the card, so the final column renders fully inside the border at 1280/1600.
defects.evidence: separate reads per viewport, terrain is approved content so only the clipping is called out

defects.observation: system pill label appears clipped or overflowing its container at the right edge in 768-dark-home; the 768-light read shows the Mission Log nav item wrapping to two lines while dark does not.
defects.fix: Keep the pill label nowrap with internal padding and shorten or icon-only the label below 820px; give nav items a single-line no-wrap rule at tablet width.
defects.evidence: single read per file, disagreeing detail between themes

defects.element: mission log 30-day bar chart, light theme
defects.observation: Bar lengths do not match values: Champions Operations (17) reads shorter than Lake B2B (11); right-aligned counts do not line up with bar ends; Champ Harbinger (1) bar nearly invisible.
defects.fix: Set bar width from value/max times track width, put the count on the same baseline as the bar end, and enforce a minimum visible width for value 1.
defects.evidence: vision read on light only, dark not flagged as mismatched
defects.status: hypothesis, parent should measure bar pixels against values

defects.observation: Header nav renders on top of the three Things to try cards and truncates the Ask Deep card body mid-sentence in section-stack; it also clips the intro lines in section-ecosystem and section-writing in both themes.
defects.fix: If the header is fixed or sticky, add scroll-padding-top and scroll-margin so anchors clear it, hide the header for section captures, and confirm live that scrolling never parks the bar over card content.
defects.evidence: identical position in dark and light, so systematic; may be a capture artifact

defects.observation: no entry heatmap cells are white on cream and nearly invisible; footer meta fine print, the ecosystem back link, folder subtitles on light blue (Data, Data and Services, Healthcare Data), and lead-scorer microcopy (feeds the fit call and your rubrics) all read as light gray on light background.
defects.fix: Darken secondary text to at least 4.5:1 on the light tokens, and give no entry cells the same visible stroke or hatch the dark theme uses.
defects.evidence: mechanical contrast audit reports zero FAILs, so treat as eyeball hypothesis

defects.element: mobile touch targets on text links
defects.observation: Parenthetical CTAs (Talk to Deep 30 min, See what I build), green text links (read day 354 in full, open the toolkit, Open ChampBeam, show plus), arc filter pills and Workpace/History/Usage tabs have no padding, so hit height equals text height; the header theme toggle circle reads smaller than 44px.
defects.fix: Add min-height 44px or block padding to these link and tab components on <=480px; keep the toggle at least 44px square.

defects.observation: Champ.fit and Health.fit style folders read as identical texture; IP Momentum texture does not follow the folder contour; Champions Infometrics is missing the last shipped day subtitle its siblings carry; one row 3 slot in the desktop grid is empty (light reads say row 3 column 4) while the section copy says twelve companies.
defects.fix: Give each company a distinct texture seed, clip textures to the folder shape, render the last shipped day subtitle uniformly, and fill or hide the empty grid slot.
defects.evidence: dark and light reads disagree by one card (10 vs 11 visible), so slot count needs DOM check

defects.observation: SITE / ELSEWHERE / THE TWELVE header tops are not level and column gaps are uneven; light footer fine print is cut mid-sentence at the right edge; back to top sits on the dot-matrix graphic.
defects.fix: Put the three columns in one grid row with equal gap and aligned headers, clamp the fine print to two lines with an ellipsis instead of a hard clip, and move the graphic behind a lower z-index with text padding.

defects.observation: Log day cards have uneven heights with blank gaps before their link (day 349 vs 348, 346 vs 347); LISTENING card is taller than sibling icon cards in section-human; SUN card sits off the 3-column grid in section-writing; ecosystem bottom row leaves empty columns.
defects.fix: Use equal-height grid rows for day cards and icon cards and one column count per breakpoint.

defects.observation: browser voice on the essay page, your browser reads this one until the AI voice is ready, feeds the fit call and your rubrics, metric card labels, log status tags, and Illustrative commands all read below comfortable contrast on their theme backgrounds.
defects.fix: Move these to the secondary-text token at or above 4.5:1 in both themes.

defects.element: Ask Deep card in Things to try
defects.observation: Card body is cut mid-sentence (stores) with no ellipsis while the sibling cards read complete.
defects.fix: Line-clamp with an ellipsis or shorten the copy so all three cards end cleanly.

defects.observation: Chat quick-reply labels are cut at the right capture border and the file is 1184px wide while sibling captures are 1280; a large empty band sits above the content.
defects.fix: Re-capture at the standard 1280 width with chat closed.

defects.observation: At 1600 a wide empty strip sits between the left column and the terrain card with the card running lower than the left column; lake-b2b leaves the entire right half empty on desktop; 375 and 768 homes leave large empty gaps around the horse graphic and between CTAs and the log block.
defects.fix: Widen the left column or cap the page grid at a max measure so columns balance, let lake-b2b content span or add the journey column, and tighten the mobile section rhythm around the graphic.

clean: pointer-mid-drag.png (drag state reads correctly: outlined active card, correctly sized origin gap, grid intact)
1280-dark-home.png and 1280-light-home.png (structure, terrain widget, legend and day 354 content consistent across themes)

mechanical_findings.internal_gap_scan: all 71 files scanned; only 375-dark-section-ecosystem, 375-light-section-ecosystem, 375-dark-folder-open, 375-light-folder-open have an internal empty band >=120px (1200px, 1200px, 600px, 600px) and a tail >=300px (~1600px each); all other files have internal gaps <120px and tails <130px

limits: Every geometric item is a hypothesis for parent probe; the mechanical audit reports zero FAILs and no live DOM was queried by this review.
Folder counts on mobile (3 and 5) and the desktop grid slot count (10 vs 11 reads) come from vision, not DOM.
Chat-open state in the captures may be intentional; P1-2 applies to that state.
One card was read twice (1280-light-section-ecosystem) to settle folder count; all other files read once.
Generated band files for section-stack were not opened; the full images were read instead.
No numerical design scores, no product or source edits, no claims about content missing at crop edges beyond the four pixel-verified empty regions.
